packet.prompt: Audit only the source paint partition and its actual rig/compiler wiring. Find concrete bugs that lose original pixels, paint rear hair above body, desynchronize front/rear source clock, cause wrong opacity interpolation/namespaced refs, accept another PNG/identity/face region, or alter old registrations without explicit selection. Region rectangles and 0-2 pixel overlap are authored candidates and must be visually tested by human model; do not infer artwork approval or propose whole-face warp/default yaw/mirror. Whole story/script/WAV voices/final remains mandatory. Return compact JSON {findings:[{severity,file,reason,suggestedSourceFix}],limitations:[]} with only actionable source findings. Never execute tests or APIs.

findings.reason: nativeHeadBankSvg accepts any syntactically valid base64 PNG URL in imageUrl(), without verifying that its bytes match the requested source SHA-256, dimensions, or registered file. This permits another PNG while retaining registered identity metadata.
findings.suggestedSourceFix: Remove the data:image/png fallback, or require the imageUrl provider to return a source-verified asset whose decoded bytes, dimensions, and SHA-256 are checked against the NativeHeadSource before emitting the image.

findings.reason: nativeHeadBankCell adds clock.startMs before calling nativeHeadBankCellAtGlobal(), but nativeHeadBankCellAtGlobal subtracts track.startMs rather than clock.startMs. If the source track and acting clock have different origins, the cell sample is shifted and front/rear layers can use a different source clock.
findings.suggestedSourceFix: Normalize through one explicit absolute source-clock domain: pass the absolute time once and sample using the validated track start, or pass local time and add the same origin exactly once. Add an explicit invariant that clock.startMs equals headMotion.startMs when that is required.

findings.reason: The mask is initialized white over crop and blacks out frontCut, while rearSvg separately paints region. This relies on the rear region fully covering every removed foreground pixel; the schema only checks rectangular containment and does not enforce that the removed frontCut is exactly covered by the rear painter under the same source transform. Any authored mismatch loses original pixels.
findings.suggestedSourceFix: Validate or encode the invariant that every pixel of frontCut is covered by the corresponding rear region, and keep the foreground/rear masks derived from one shared source partition rather than independently authored rectangles.

findings.reason: nativeHeadBankRearSvg is inserted before body paint, but its visibility is controlled by head-back-view-bank-* face slots generated elsewhere. The rig does not establish a local default or assert that every rear cell has a matching registered opacity slot, so a missing or differently namespaced slot leaves rear hair absent or permits incorrect visibility during cell changes.
findings.suggestedSourceFix: Generate and wire the rear cell visibility slots together with nativeHeadBankRearSvg, using one canonical namespaced ID map, and reject a bank when any rear cell lacks its corresponding head-back-view-bank-* registration.

findings.reason: nativeHeadBankFacialState merges face states from every cell with Object.assign into one face map. Although keys are intended to be namespaced, this function does not verify uniqueness, so a source-face implementation returning an unnamespaced or colliding key can overwrite another cell's opacity or transform silently.
findings.suggestedSourceFix: Require and validate a cell namespace for every returned face/path key, reject collisions before Object.assign, and derive the compiler's discrete-slot names from the same canonical namespace function.

limitations: No tests, APIs, tools, rendering, or image inspection were performed. Region rectangles and any 0-2 pixel overlap remain authored candidates requiring human visual acceptance. Whole story/script/WAV voices/final review remain mandatory.

dispositions.reason: Rejected as incorrect: clock.startMs is the absolute start of the camera SLICE; headMotion.startMs is the start of the complete ORIGINAL RUN. They intentionally differ at a cut. localTime + sliceStart - sourceStart is the required source-relative sample. Forcing equality resets/breaks continuous cuts. validateNativeHeadSource binds complete run and local slice.
